verdict.rationale: Cooley GO shows some non-US content (a UK mutual NDA template, a UK/Singapore YC SAFE variant) and Cooley has offices in London, Singapore, Hong Kong, Beijing, but there is no evidence of jurisdiction-specific instrument coverage like UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, or French BSPCE — the 'France' URL citations are actually about US S-1 drafting, not French startup law. missing for 10: documented UK EMI scheme guidance, German VSOP templates/rules, Indian FDI/ESOP guidance, French BSPCE documents or guidance.
